tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. Read the scene's bars across the floor and back wall behind it as a beam reaching the product first: one hard-edged bar crosses the phone at camera-plateau height, each of the three lens rings taking its own crescent, everything above and below it falling two stops. The cove is true oxblood, dark brownish red nearer dried blood than crimson, so the charcoal back separates from it. The phone stands upright on the plinth, back to camera, three-fifths of frame height, a hard shadow pooling where its base meets the plinth top, no gap at the contact. One hard-cut kicker from camera-right, a sliver and never soft fill, draws the flat titanium edge as one unbroken white line. AXIOM is laser-etched in wide-spaced capitals low on the back, big enough to read at a glance, lit only where the bar crosses it. 100mm at f/4 at plinth height, dead square, gobo high from camera-left, windowless studio, no daylight hour. Plinth out the bottom, cove out both sides, wall out the top.
